name: b-fly-b16
method: disarmed drop from the spawn until contact or 0.5 s, a = 2(Δy + v0 t)/t²

rows.warning: With the same motors under 1.62 m/s² the craft has about 6.1× the thrust-to-weight it has on Earth: it will be very twitchy. "Keep thrust / weight" makes it feel normal. The air is Earth air everywhere — gravity is a game setting here.
